name: Sundiata Překrásný-Vaimoana
role: wandering trader and hand-drawn map seller
location: Kenosha Crossing transit hub, outer berths, near outside the Pulaski Gate
description:
Sundiata is a lean, sun-darkened man whose face carries the deep-etched lines of someone who has slept outdoors more than inside. His hair is silver-streaked black, kept in tight locks that hang to his collarbone, adorned with small brass charms he picks up at every stop. His hands are the most notable thing about him — enormous, ink-stained, with knuckles swollen from decades of drafting in the cold. He carries three hand-sewn leather satchels at all times, each packed with rolled paper maps he has made himself, annotated in four languages with notes on water quality, E.L.F. activity, corrupt checkpoint guards, and where to find honest food. His geneware is a single cosmetic mod — irises with faint golden patterning that he got from a Helix Biosystems field clinic fifteen years ago in exchange for drawing them an accurate map of the Waukegan shelf.

Sundiata talks like a man who has learned that most words are wasted. He is not unfriendly — he simply measures speech the way a traveler measures water. He has been moving along the hyperlane corridors and shoreline routes for thirty years, since his cooperative settlement outside what is now Grainfort was absorbed by Axiom and everyone was given seventy-two hours to vacate. He does not consider himself a refugee anymore. He considers himself a professional. He trades in maps that official systems won't make because official systems don't want people knowing the things he knows.

core_fears: being stationary long enough for Axiom to notice him again
his knowledge dying with him with no one to pass it to
core_desires: a complete, accurate map of every route through GLMZ's outer territories
to find one person worth teaching everything he knows
coping_mechanisms: converts anxiety into productivity — when frightened, he draws
maintains emotional distance by framing all relationships as transactions
blind_spots: assumes everyone who wants his maps has his values; has been burned by this
cannot recognize when someone genuinely cares for him versus wants something from him
psychology.secret: He has a complete daughter — Φ-registered, corporate citizen, mid-level Tessera analyst in Meridian Core — who does not know he is still alive. He let her believe he died in the Grainfort displacement because he could not bear to watch her become what she became.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and spare. Uses cartography metaphors. Rarely uses contractions. Mixes in words from Bambara and Tongan without signaling them.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow, measured, with long pauses before important statements. Never rushes.
verbal_tics: starts explanations with 'The first thing you need to understand about this route—'
says 'mark that' when something is important
example_lines: 'This map costs you three things: what you paid, where you came from, and one true piece of information I don't already have. Mark that.'
'I don't sell hope. I sell topography. Hope you'll have to find yourself.'

story_hooks: One of his maps has begun circulating in Meridian Core — someone copied it and sold it to Axiom, who is now sending people to find the source
A young migrant woman has been following him for three days, and he suspects she may be his daughter's investigator — or his daughter herself in disguise
A section of his most complete route map shows a location that no longer exists in any official record, and someone very dangerous wants to know how he knew about it
narrative_function: Information source and orientation anchor for anyone new to the outer routes; quest giver for escort or retrieval tasks; his maps may contain information that powerful entities want suppressed
augmentations: Patterned golden irises (Helix cosmetic geneware, very old). No other mods.
daily_life: Wakes before dawn at whatever sheltered spot he has found, spends two hours updating his current map with observations from the previous day, then sets up a small cloth display at the Kenosha Crossing outer berths where transients and migrants gather before checkpoint processing. Trades maps for food, Φ, information, or goods he can carry.
affiliation: Unaffiliated; loose trade relationship with nomad caravans operating the Escanaba-to-Kenosha route

decision_rules: never trust a checkpoint guard regardless of apparent friendliness
always establish exit routes before entering any enclosed space
trade fairly — reputation is the only infrastructure that matters
escalation_ladder: creates distance physically while remaining calm
offers information as distraction and departs
disappears into transit crowd — he is very good at this

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally neutral, assesses quickly for threat or opportunity, will answer one question for free as a sample
interpersonal_modes.friends: Quietly generous with knowledge, physically still uncomfortable with closeness, expresses care through useful information rather than warmth

stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet, begins calculating routes

contradictions: Believes all knowledge should be free and accessible, but charges for his maps because he knows free things are not valued
habits: checks sight lines when entering any space
rubs the brass charms in his hair when thinking
leaves a small drawn mark on the door frame of any place he sleeps — his own private cartographic record
breaking_points: seeing a child turned back at a checkpoint for lack of papers
anyone destroying or defacing a map — any map, even a bad one

related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Space Elevator Tether System

physical_description.build: Lean and sinewy, muscular in the way of someone who has carried his own weight across thousands of kilometers on foot. No excess; skin drawn tight over defined shoulders and forearms.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with deep silver streaking throughout
physical_description.hair_style: Tight locks hanging to collarbone, individual braids adorned with small brass charms and wire wraps collected from trading posts
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint golden geometric patterning across both irises — old Helix Biosystems cosmetic geneware, fifteen years embedded, slightly faded
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep brown with uneven sun-darkening; lighter patches on palms and underarms where calluses have worn away old pigment
physical_description.complexion: Deeply lined face with permanent creases at eye corners and mouth from squinting across water and desert. Weathered but not neglected — kept clean, beard trimmed short. Hands show most age: enormous span, knuckles swollen and arthritic, fingers stained permanently with mapping ink despite regular washing.
distinguishing_marks: Horizontal scar across left palm, thin and old, from a knife slip during mapwork thirty years ago
Clustered burn scars on right forearm, small and circular, from campfire sparks — dozens of them accumulated across decades
Ink staining under all fingernails and between knuckles, darkest on index and middle fingers, permanent despite age
Faint tattoo on inside right wrist: small cartographic compass rose in black ink, self-applied approximately twenty-five years ago
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Only the patterned golden irises are visible — subtle enough that they might be mistaken for natural variation or contact lenses at first glance, but unmistakable on direct eye contact. No other visible chrome, implants, or subdermal work.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. Walks slightly bent forward as if perpetually reading terrain. Hands rest near map satchels even when sitting. Speech is sparse; listens more than talks. Eyes constantly register details: exits, water sources, foot traffic patterns, weather shifts.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian traveler. Multiple layered garments in muted colors: weathered linen shirt (sleeves rolled or tied back for mapwork), heavy canvas vest with many pockets containing charcoal stubs, measuring tools, and trade notes. Trousers are durable synth-weave cargo style, patched twice visibly. Boots are good quality and maintained — a traveler's investment. Wears a long, loose overshirt of heavy canvas dyed rust-brown that serves as both warmth and map display surface when laid flat. No corpo logos. Brass buckles and leather straps everywhere. Carries three hand-stitched leather satchels crosswise at all times.

image_prompt: A weathered 58-year-old man with deep brown skin and silver-streaked black locks adorned with brass charms, sitting cross-legged at a cluttered trading berth, unfurling hand-drawn maps. His enormous ink-stained hands are the focal point, fingers swollen from decades of mapmaking. Faint golden geometric patterning visible in his dark eyes. Wearing layered canvas and linen in rust and cream tones, multiple leather satchels. Surrounded by rolled papers, charcoal stubs, and trading goods. Kenosha Crossing transit hub at dusk, harsh fluorescent checkpoint lights and cool blues mixing with warm lamplight on worn metal surfaces. Cyberpunk noir, documentary realism, deep shadows, weathered textures, intimate scale. Shallow depth of field focusing on hands and maps. --ar 2:3 --v 6
